title: fagara diabolica
intro: Fagara diabolica, commonly known as the devil pepper or Chinese prickly ash, is a plant species in the family Rutaceae, native to southern China. It is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to aid digestion, alleviate respiratory issues, and boost the immune system. The plant is known for its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Fagara diabolica include alkaloids, terpenoids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in traditional Chinese medicine.
